scheme_name: Himachal Pradesh Chief Minister's Mahila Sashaktikaran Yojana
description: Financial assistance for women's self-help groups and individual women entrepreneurs.
Eligible: Women residents of Himachal Pradesh, age 18–59 years.
Provides corpus fund for SHGs and individual loans with subsidy.
Priority to SC/ST women.
npa_percentage: Approx. 5.3% gross NPA (FY 2025-26, Regional Rural Banks)
maximum_benefit: Corpus fund for SHGs + individual loans up to ₹5 lakh with subsidy

description: Income support scheme for farmers.
Eligible: Farmer families in Jharkhand, landholding up to 5 acres.
Provides ₹5,000 per year per family.
Aim: support agricultural activities and rural livelihoods.
npa_percentage: Approx. 5.3% gross NPA (FY 2025-26, Regional Rural Banks)
maximum_benefit: ₹5,000 per year per farmer family

description: Free bicycle distribution to students for education.
Eligible: Students studying in Class 9–12, family income below ₹2 lakh/year.
Provides bicycle or ₹5,000 for bicycle purchase.
Priority to SC/ST, girls, rural students.
channel_partner_name: School Office + District Education Office, Odisha
maximum_benefit: Free bicycle or ₹5,000 for bicycle purchase

description: Scheme for procurement of cow dung from cattle owners.
Eligible: Cattle owners in Chhattisgarh, including SC/ST, women, farmers.
Government procures cow dung at ₹2 per kg.
Aim: support rural economy and promote organic farming.
channel_partner_name: Gram Panchayat Office, Village – Raipur, Chhattisgarh
maximum_benefit: ₹2 per kg of cow dung procured

scheme_name: Gujarat Chief Minister's Yuva Swavlamban Yojana
description: Interest subsidy on education loans for youth.
Eligible: Gujarat domicile, pursuing higher education, family income below ₹6 lakh/year.
Provides 50% interest subsidy on education loans.
Priority to SC/ST, OBC, women students.
npa_percentage: Approx. 1.9% gross NPA (FY 2025-26, Public Sector Banks)
maximum_benefit: 50% interest subsidy on education loan

scheme_name: Maharashtra Chief Minister's Scholarship for SC/ST Students
description: Scholarship for SC/ST students pursuing higher education.
Eligible: SC/ST students, Maharashtra domicile, family income below ₹2.5 lakh/year.
Provides ₹50,000–₹1,00,000 per year depending on course.
Covers tuition fees and maintenance.
documents_required: Current year admission proof and fee receipt
channel_partner_name: District Social Welfare Office + Maharashtra Scholarship Portal
maximum_benefit: ₹50,000–₹1,00,000 per year depending on course

description: Financial assistance for self-employment ventures.
Eligible: Goa domicile, age 18–45 years, family income below ₹5 lakh/year.
Provides project financing up to ₹25 lakh with interest rebate.
Priority to women, SC/ST, OBC youth.
npa_percentage: Approx. 1.9% gross NPA (FY 2025-26, Public Sector Banks)
maximum_benefit: Project financing up to ₹25 lakh with interest rebate

description: Financial assistance for SC/ST/BC women aged 45–60 years.
Eligible: Women, age 45–60 years, from SC/ST/BC categories, Andhra Pradesh domicile.
Provides ₹18,750 per year for 4 years (total ₹75,000).
Aim: economic empowerment of women.
channel_partner_name: District Rural Development Agency (DRDA) Office, Andhra Pradesh
maximum_benefit: ₹18,750 per year for 4 years (total ₹75,000)

description: Stipend-based apprenticeship for educated youth.
Eligible: Karnataka domicile, age 21–35 years, graduate/diploma holder.
Provides monthly stipend during apprenticeship period.
Priority to women, SC/ST, OBC youth.
maximum_benefit: Monthly stipend during apprenticeship (₹5,000–₹10,000 per month)

description: State scheme supporting startups with funding, mentorship, and infrastructure.
Eligible: Kerala-based startups in innovation/technology sectors.
Provides equity funding, grants, and incubation support.
Priority to women, SC/ST entrepreneurs.
documents_required: Startup registration with Kerala Startup Mission
maximum_benefit: Equity funding up to ₹50 lakh, plus grants and incubation support

scheme_name: Tamil Nadu Chief Minister's Comprehensive Health Insurance Scheme
description: Health insurance scheme for all Tamil Nadu residents.
Eligible: All Tamil Nadu residents, no income bar.
Provides health insurance coverage up to ₹5 lakh per family per year.
Cashless treatment at empanelled hospitals.
documents_required: Aadhaar card of all family members
channel_partner_name: District Health Office + CSC centre, Tamil Nadu
maximum_benefit: Health insurance coverage up to ₹5 lakh per family per year

description: Financial assistance for marriage of SC/ST/BC minority girls.
Eligible: SC/ST/BC minority girls, age 18+ years, family income below ₹2 lakh/year.
Provides ₹1,00,116 for marriage expenses.
Aim: reduce child marriage and support poor families.
documents_required: Aadhaar card of bride and parents
channel_partner_name: Mee Seva Centre + District Social Welfare Office, Telangana
maximum_benefit: ₹1,00,116 for marriage expenses

description: Conditional cash transfer scheme for girl child education and marriage.
Eligible: Unmarried girls, age 13–18 years, studying in Class 8–12, family income below ₹1.2 lakh/year.
Provides annual scholarship ₹750 (K1) and one-time grant ₹25,000 at age 18 (K2).
Aim: prevent child marriage and promote education.
npa_percentage: Approx. 1.9% gross NPA (FY 2025-26, Public Sector Banks)
maximum_benefit: ₹750 annual scholarship + ₹25,000 one-time grant at age 18

description: Scholarship for OBC students studying after Class 10.
Covers tuition fees, exam fees, and maintenance allowance.
Eligible: OBC students, family income below ₹2.5 lakh/year.
Must be studying in recognised institutions.
documents_required: Current year admission proof and fee receipt
channel_partner_name: District Social Welfare Office + NSP portal
maximum_benefit: Full tuition/exam fees + maintenance allowance

scheme_name: Central Sector Scholarship for College Students (CSSS)
description: Merit-based scholarship for students who scored 80th percentile or above in Class 12.
Provides ₹12,000 per year for UG and ₹20,000 per year for PG studies.
Eligible: Indian citizens, family income below ₹8 lakh/year, studying in recognised institutions.
No caste restriction; merit-based.
documents_required: Current course admission/enrollment proof with AISHE code
maximum_benefit: ₹12,000 per year (UG) or ₹20,000 per year (PG)

description: Scholarship for top 1% Class 12 science students for higher education in science.
Eligible: Top 1% in Class 12 board exams (science stream), pursuing B.Sc./M.Sc. in basic/natural sciences.
Provides ₹80,000 per year (₹60,000 + ₹20,000 for project).
Duration: up to 5 years.
documents_required: Admission proof in B.Sc./M.Sc. science course
maximum_benefit: ₹80,000 per year for up to 5 years

description: Fellowship for OBC students pursuing M.Phil and Ph.D.
Eligible: OBC students, cleared UGC-NET/CSIR-NET or equivalent, family income below ₹6 lakh/year.
Provides ₹31,000 per month (JRF) and ₹35,000 per month (SRF).
Duration: up to 5 years.
maximum_benefit: ₹31,000–₹35,000 per month for up to 5 years

description: Scholarship for OBC students studying in Class 9 and 10.
Eligible: OBC students, family income below ₹2.5 lakh/year.
Covers admission fees, tuition fees, maintenance allowance.
Implemented through states/UTs.
channel_partner_name: District Social Welfare Office + School, NSP portal
maximum_benefit: Admission/tuition fees + maintenance allowance

scheme_name: Dr. Ambedkar Post-Matric Scholarship for EBC Students
description: Scholarship for Economically Backward Class (EBC) students studying after Class 10.
Eligible: EBC students, family income below ₹2.5 lakh/year.
Covers tuition fees, exam fees, and maintenance allowance.
Implemented through states/UTs.
documents_required: Current year admission proof and fee receipt
channel_partner_name: District Social Welfare Office + NSP portal
maximum_benefit: Full tuition/exam fees + maintenance allowance

scheme_name: Scheme for Higher Education of J&K Migrant Students
description: Scholarship for migrant students from Jammu & Kashmir pursuing higher education.
Eligible: Migrant students from J&K, family income below ₹6 lakh/year.
Provides tuition fees, maintenance allowance, and other expenses.
Implemented through AICTE and states.
documents_required: Current year admission proof and fee receipt
maximum_benefit: Full tuition fees + maintenance allowance

scheme_name: Scheme for Education of Children of Primary School Teachers
description: Scholarship for children of deceased primary school teachers.
Eligible: Children of deceased primary school teachers, studying in recognised institutions.
Provides ₹2,500 per month for 10 months.
Implemented through states/UTs.
documents_required: Death certificate of parent (primary school teacher)
maximum_benefit: ₹2,500 per month for 10 months

scheme_name: Scheme for Providing Quality Education in Madrasas (SPQEM)
description: Financial assistance for modern education in madrasas.
Eligible: Madrasa students, no income bar.
Provides honorarium for teachers of modern subjects, learning materials, and infrastructure support.
Implemented through states/UTs.
maximum_benefit: Free modern education in madrasas + teacher honorarium

scheme_name: Scheme for Infrastructure Development in Minority Institutions (IDMI)
description: Financial assistance for infrastructure development in minority educational institutions.
Eligible: Minority educational institutions (Muslim, Sikh, Christian, Buddhist, Jain, Parsi).
Provides grant for construction of buildings, laboratories, libraries, hostels.
Implemented through states/UTs.
channel_partner_name: State Minority Commission + District Education Office
maximum_benefit: Grant for infrastructure development (varies by project, typically ₹50 lakh–₹2 crore)

description: Scholarship for meritorious girls from minority communities.
Eligible: Girls from minority communities, Class 9–12, family income below ₹2 lakh/year.
Provides ₹10,000 per year for 10 months.
Aim: promote education among minority girls.
channel_partner_name: School + District Minority Welfare Office, Maulana Azad Education Foundation
maximum_benefit: ₹10,000 per year for 10 months

description: Fellowship for students from minority communities pursuing M.Phil and Ph.D.
Eligible: Students from minority communities (Muslim, Sikh, Christian, Buddhist, Jain, Parsi), cleared UGC-NET/CSIR-NET or equivalent.
Provides ₹31,000 per month (JRF) and ₹35,000 per month (SRF).
Duration: up to 5 years.
maximum_benefit: ₹31,000–₹35,000 per month for up to 5 years
